# Password reset

## REQ-1 Reset token store

The system shall store each reset token hashed, bound to one user.

- REQ-1.AC-1: Given a reset request When a token is issued Then only its hash is stored.

## REQ-2 Reset endpoint

When a user submits a valid, unexpired token, the system shall set the new password.

- REQ-2.AC-1: Given an expired token When it is submitted Then the reset is refused with 410.
